1.mascotDialogue: The pivot does not move again after partitioning — she is already home! Everything left to sort is strictly smaller on one side, strictly bigger on the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 places the pivot at her final resting index. Lines 16 and 17 recurse on the strictly-smaller and strictly-bigger sides — the pivot herself is never touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happened to be the smallest value, so she ends up all the way at index 0 — an unlucky pivot choice, and a fine example of why selection matters for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character out of place — p instead of p minus one — and the recursion loses her most important guarantee: that every recursive call works on a strictly smaller range than the one before.
